person.name: William H. Reed
person.notes: Obituary Record: interment in the adjoining cemetery

obituaries.full_text:
DOVER: William H. Reed, 92, of near Dover, a retired farmer, died Sunday at home after a brief illness. He was the husband of the late Beulah Morgan Reed who died many years ago.

Survivors include two sons, Thomas Reed of Dover and Harry Reed of Wilmington; three grandchildren and five great-grandchildren.

Services will be held Thursday afternoon at 1 from Immanuel Union Methodist Church, Townsend, with interment in the adjoining cemetery. Friends may call tomorrow night at the Torbert Funeral Home, Dover.

Rebecca Reed

REED- In Philadelphia, Pa. on Dec. 8, 
1958
, Rebecca Reed, sister of Mrs. Caroline Wright and Mrs. Alice Webb of Millsboro and Levin Jackson of Wilmington, Del. Aged 87 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend the funeral services at the Stevenson Funeral Home, Dover, Del. on Saturday afternoon Dec. 13 at 1:30 o'clock. Interment at Fork Branch Cemetery. Friends may call Friday evening from 7 to 9 o'clock.

William H. Reed  
Oct. 15, 
1967
